tasks.gr12-careers-and-career-choices-t4: Topic: Careers and Career Choices. Cover post-school pathways, admissions requirements, bursaries, entrepreneurship and lifelong learning. Ask Grade 12 learners to compare study or training options, identify entry requirements, evaluate funding possibilities, or explain how interests and strengths connect to realistic career choices.
tasks.gr12-world-of-work-readiness-t4: Topic: World of Work Readiness. Cover CV writing, interviews, workplace ethics, contracts, labour rights and professional conduct. Ask learners to improve job-seeking documents, evaluate workplace scenarios, identify labour-rights issues, or explain how professionalism affects employability.
tasks.gr12-transition-and-personal-planning-t4: Topic: Transition and Personal Planning. Cover financial awareness, independence, support networks, resilience and future planning for the first year after school. Ask learners to evaluate readiness for adult responsibilities, plan a simple budget, identify support systems, or create an action plan for post-school transition.
tasks.gr12-physical-education-task-4-t4: Topic: Physical Education Task — Term 4. Cover lifetime fitness, recreation choices, healthy routines, participation evidence and sustainable activity goals for adult life. Ask learners to reflect on long-term fitness habits, evaluate recreation options, or set practical activity goals for the year after school.
